local_primary_source_findings.publication_profile_lifetime: Archive::snapshot clones the same Arc<Mutex<PublicationProfile>>; the initial benchmark pin retains it after actual last-owner writer join.
local_primary_source_findings.diagnostic_driver_change_to_declare_befo: Read pin.stats()?.publication_profile after drop(live) actually joins the writer and before dropping the pin. Serialize the profile after all timing intervals. Use the identical common driver in baseline and candidate.
local_primary_source_findings.stats_observation_caveat: Existing LiveStats is sampled before the last-owner join and could miss final maintenance; profile collected after the join must be reconciled against cold final generation and exact archive metadata.
local_primary_source_findings.causal_limit: These aggregate counters do not isolate a tail-latency cause. Zero selected wait rules out reducing intentional collection wait as the sparse-workload fix. Per-stage evidence is required before publication/maintenance optimization.

primary_sources_verified.finding: Frequent separate durable flushes can incur disk-cache costs. This supports measuring sync stages; it does not establish the cause or size of a Kestrel regression.
File::sync_all is the API for explicitly synchronizing file state; actual local Rust version is1.97.1, while current online documentation is1.99.0.
Scoped threads are joined before the scope returns. Concurrent publication is only a future hypothesis requiring measured justification and a separate declared engine trial, not an adopted fix.
